author: cairn
blurb: Review recent git changes for bugs, edge cases, and security issues.

definition.name: find-bugs
definition.description: Review recent changes for bugs and risks
definition.insertText: Review the recent changes for problems. Run `git diff` (and `git diff --staged`) and analyse it for bugs, unhandled edge cases, race conditions, and security issues. List findings grouped by severity (High / Medium / Low), each with the file and a suggested fix.
